newsitem.title: DENMARK: Kleinwort downgrades BG Bank to hold.
newsitem.headline: Kleinwort downgrades BG Bank to hold.

text.p: Investment bank Kleinwort Benson said on Friday that it was altering its recommendation on Denmark's BG Bank to hold from buy as it considers that a flurry of recent rumour mergers have driven the shares above a reasonable value.

"We had to reduce the recommendation to hold, because it has risen so much. What is happening is nothing fundamental but pure speculation so there is nothing dramatic (in the downgrade)," Kleinwort analyst Tage Fabrin-Brasted told Reuters.
The share has gained some 10 percent over the past week, closing on Friday at 365 crowns after an earlier high of 375. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650
